title: Record founder request for a one-release G7 staging exception
context: The founder explicitly requested production publication without a staging environment because every current account is a test account and no customer data is present.
decision: Approve requesting a G7-only staging-acceptance exception for one production-release attempt of candidate 0a95d10cdf96fd3b3e85ad7c42b2ac3f4b72d71c to TARGET-PRODUCTION-OPINIUP. This does not waive security, privacy, migration, operational readiness, internal release approval, production verification, monitoring, or audit point 26.
assumptions: All current accounts are test accounts.
No customer data is present in the production target.
invalidated_by: Discovery of non-test or customer data
Any G6 or G9 alert or rollback trigger
Completion or abortion of the single release attempt
remaining_blockers: Qualified independent human penetration test and retest required by audit point 26
Positive G8 release decision on the exact final candidate
G6 operational readiness and G9 post-deployment verification
